model: AXIS Camera Station S1296 Rack Recording Server
series: AXIS Camera Station S12 Recording Server Series

storage.built_in: S1296 Rack 96 TB: 96 TB (12x8 TB) hot-swappable Enterprise Class SAS HDD, 80 TB after factory RAID 6. S1296 Rack 192 TB: 192 TB (12x16 TB), 160 TB after factory RAID 6. 2x 480 GB SSD operating system drives in RAID 1

power.supply: 2 x 800 W hot-plug redundant power supplies (100–240 V AC, 12–6.3 A, 50/60 Hz)

features: 96 AXIS Camera Station Pro Core Device NVR licenses and 10 AXIS Audio Manager Pro licenses included
Qualified for 192 doors, recording bitrate up to 1.5 Gbit/s, 150 video channels at 4 MP, 30 fps in a retail scenario
2x RJ45 10 Gbps; 2x RJ45 1 Gbps marked 'Do not use'
Not intended for local viewing of video; Axis workstations recommended
iDRAC 9 express license; 1x iDRAC dedicated Ethernet port
Can be scaled with more devices when using AXIS S30 Recorder Series
Qualified for 200 simultaneous audio streams using AXIS Audio Manager Pro
Qualified for up to 1,000 doors with access control only
FIPS 140-2 level 2 certified Trusted Platform Module (TPM 2.0); support for encrypted operating system and recording drives
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption of 260 W typical and 280 W maximum.
weight_g is for the 96 TB variant; datasheet gives 26.1 kg (96 TB) and 26.3 kg (192 TB).
dimensions_mm: 86.8 x 482 x 707.78 (height x width x depth without bezel)
